dct_description_sm: This GIS data (polygon .shp file) is based upon variables in an excel spreadsheet that Michelle Edwards, Data Librarian, University of Guelph, edwardsm@uoguelph.ca put together for the 2011 Census of Agriculture. Only the data from the first sheet "FarmType_LandUse" has been included. The census consolidated subdivision (CCS) population totals for 1991, 1996, 2001, 2006, and 2011 have been appended. If you require the full excel spread sheet please contact Larry Laliberte GIS Librarian, University of Alberta Libraries.
dct_rights_sm: This dataset is made available with limited information on how it can be used. You may wish to communicate with the Contact(s) specified before use.
dct_title_s: Farm Type and Land Use Variables for Alberta 2011 Census of Agriculture
